notes.title: Casting Whispers Launches in October 2025, Demo Out Now!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! I’m Lantern Bay, the developer of [b]Casting Whispers[/b], and I want to thank you for checking out my debut game![/p][p]I started my journey in video games as a sound designer. I’ve had the immense privilege to work on games like [i]Horizon Zero Dawn[/i], [i]League of Legends[/i], [i]Westworld Awakening[/i], and so many more with amazing people and teams. I’ve also DM'd for Dungeons & Dragons for years, crafting my own homebrew worlds and systems, and designing new mechanics from scratch. Storytelling is in my DNA, and I’m always excited about new ways to approach it.[/p][p]My favorite games are all about atmosphere; games where you can stop and sit for a moment and really feel the vibe of the space around you, through sound, music, art, and lighting. So when I made Lantern Bay Entertainment, that was what I wanted to do: make atmosphere. Create places that feel just as unique and special when you stand still as when you’re moving.[/p][p]After working in game development for nearly a decade, I decided that I wanted to make a horror game. Horror has the unique ability to make us freeze, whether out of fear or relief. We stop, we listen, and we soak it in. Some of my absolute favorite horror games are [i]Amnesia: The Dark Descent[/i], [i]SOMA[/i], [i]Observer[/i], [i]Scratches[/i], [i]The Mortuary Assistant[/i], and [i]Conrad Stevenson's Paranormal P.I[/i]. I wanted to design something that gave players the same sort of feeling I get when I play the greats.[/p][h2][b]Introducing Casting Whispers — Coming October 2025[/b][/h2][p][b]1961. Corburgh, Connecticut, USA.[/b] An old industrial city plagued by urban legends, the sins of its past, and unexplained phenomena. For Victoria, a lab assistant working in the field of psychic and mental psychology known as Extra-Sensory Perception (ESP), Corburgh was always home. A place to study and learn.[/p][p]But tonight, something is very wrong with her trusted mentor, Professor Henry Zubringer. Something lies in wait at his apartment building. Something that has sat hidden in the heart of Corburgh for a very long time. Enter the shadows within 1195 Norman Ave., and investigate what happened there in a desperate attempt to save the Professor from the horrors within.[/p][p][b]Key Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]First-Person Psychological Horror: [/b]Sound is your only hope for survival in this first-person psychological horror game. Investigate the mysteries of an apartment block in 1960s America terrorized by a cosmic horror, as you try to save your lost mentor… and yourself.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enter Corburgh, 1961: [/b]Step into an old American city haunted by its past and unexplained entities. The environmental and narrative designs of [i]Casting Whispers[/i] are inspired by Americana and Lovecraftian tales. What secrets lie in the shadows of this old industrial city?[/p][/*][*][p][b]Investigate Paranormal Phenomena: [/b]A malevolent entity stalks the darkness at the Professor’s apartment. Make discoveries, piece together the full mystery of Professor Henry’s disappearance, and survive that which hunts you. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Listen For The Truth, Listen For Survival:[/b] Shut your eyes, calm your mind, and listen to the darkness. The Listening feature can be used to eavesdrop on secret conversations behind doors, find hidden mechanisms, and hear that which cannot be seen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Explore Multiple Endings:[/b] This single-player linear narrative unfolds across 6–8 hours of gameplay, with multiple endings that can be unlocked depending on chance or your own choices. How many endings will you dare to find?[/p][/*][*][p][b]Behold Sounds of Terror:[/b] Music by Ed Lima, violin solos by Kim Levin, full voice acting by union talent, and original sound design by Lantern Bay combine to deliver a terrifying soundscape that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Taking inspiration from film noir, Bernard Herman, and 1960s cinema, the soundtrack was recorded with era-appropriate equipment while incorporating modern synthetic elements during more surreal moments.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Free Steam Demo Available Now[/b][/h2][p]After years of development, my game is finally nearing its release on Steam in [b]October 2025[/b]. A free [b]demo [/b]is out now, so you can delve into the darkness at 1195 Norman Ave. early and get a taste of the terror to come.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431450/Casting_Whispers/"][/dynamiclink]I would love to hear what you think about the demo! Be sure to drop a comment on this post, on Steam Discussions, or over on [url="https://discord.com/invite/fVBNtZefus"][u]Discord[/u][/url] to share your thoughts.[/p][h2][b]Thank You For Your Support![/b][/h2][p]Though I’m a solo developer, nobody is truly alone, and I could not have made it without the wonderful support of everyone who helped me. To all the talented actors, creative sanity-checkers, contractors, and my friends and family who supported me and gave me encouragement when I was at my most exhausted: thank you. To say I’m deeply appreciative of all of you would be an understatement.[/p][p]Good entertainment and art should prepare us for the next day. Whether that’s by teaching us new empathy, giving us new skills, introducing us to new thoughts, reflecting our own thoughts back at us, giving us time to connect with friends, or just giving us a period of peace and focus, these things all better prepare us for tomorrow.[/p][p]So whether you’re just joining this journey or you’ve been on for the ride for a while, I really hope you enjoy it. Thank you for being here![/p][p align="center"][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2406880/Casting_Whispers/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Add Casting Whispers to your Steam wishlist[/b] for more news about the game, development insights, and to receive notifications about the launch in [b]October 2025[/b]. I’ll see you all in Corburgh real soon![/p][p][b]– Lantern Bay[/b][/p]
